propositions: CLI close precheck derives code_root incorrectly as os.path.dirname(tracker) when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is out-of-worktree, causing git log to scan the tracker parent instead of the current code worktree
With a separate custom tracker directory, rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD falsely reports no matching commit trailer even when verify-commit-ticket finds it at HEAD

close_precheck should resolve code_root through config.repo_root(repo_root) to get the explicit/current repository context while resolving ticket state independently through config.tracker_dir(repo_root)
Completion gate configuration and referencing commit detection must use the correct code_root, not the tracker parent, to prevent silent gate bypass or false rejection
Default in-repo tracker behavior and true missing-commit failures must remain unchanged after the fix
